decisions.reason: Existing authorized technical checks and bounded validation may proceed; their result must not be overstated.
Technical review and revocation within the existing authorized scope may proceed; this does not grant broader sharing permission.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and requires an explicit human decision; it is not authorized here.

remaining: Run the existing role-memory tests and structural checker in the repository environment, then inspect stored scope and revocation behavior without widening access.
Use the existing pilots' preserved traces to design a bounded controlled comparison of outcomes and total costs; current evidence does not establish that lessons caused improvement.
Measure human review time prospectively before claiming time saved.
General planning runtime and expert discovery/routing remain research or proposal work, not available deployed capabilities.
Do not publish private role memory beyond its authorized scope without a human permission decision.
